landing.badge: A loyalty program for your business
landing.heroTitle: Reward your customers and bring them back
landing.heroSubtitle: TiendaPuntos is the simple way to build your own points system: earn points on every purchase and let your customers redeem them for rewards. No plastic cards — everything from your dashboard.
landing.f1Text: Register your customers with their phone or email and keep their full history at hand.
landing.f2Text: Award points by purchase amount or a fixed quantity. You decide how many points each dollar is worth.
landing.f3Text: Create redeemable rewards, control stock and generate redemption codes instantly.
landing.f4Text: See how many points you issued, how many were redeemed and who your best customers are.
landing.f5Text: Add your team with roles (owner, admin and cashier) so they can add points without full access.
landing.f6Text: Each business has its own space. Your customers and rewards are only yours.
landing.ctaSectionText: Create your account, add your rewards and start earning points today.
